get.description: Whether the API runs and reaches the database.

post.description: Creates an account and signs it in.
Signs an account in with its email and password.

delete.description: Signs the account out in every browser.

post.description: Creates a team, with the signed-in account as its owner.

get.description: A team of the signed-in account.

patch.description: Changes a team's name or URL.

delete.description: Deletes a team, with its projects and components.

get.description: A team's members, in the order they joined.

put.description: Makes a member of a team one of its owners.

delete.description: Takes a member out of a team and its projects. Owners leave by themselves.
Takes the signed-in account out of a team and its projects.

get.description: A team's invite link. A new one if the last one has expired.
The team that an invite link joins. Also for someone not signed in.

post.description: Adds the signed-in account to an invite link's team as a member.

get.description: The team's projects that the signed-in account can see, the most recently edited first. Owners see them all.

post.description: Creates a project in the team, with the signed-in account as its first lead.

get.description: A project that the signed-in account can see.

patch.description: Changes a project's name or description. A new name gives it a new URL.

delete.description: Deletes a project, with its components.

get.description: A project's members, in the order they were added.

put.description: Adds a member of the team to a project with the role, or gives them the role if they're in it.

delete.description: Takes a member out of a project.
Takes the signed-in account out of a project. Its only lead makes someone else a lead first.

get.description: A project's components, in the order they were created.

post.description: Creates a component with an empty graph and the default screen sizes.

get.description: A component, with its graph and screen sizes.

patch.description: Gives a component a new name.

put.description: Saves a component's graph and screen sizes. Answers 409 if someone else saved it after the version the save started from.

post.description: Copies a component, as FeatureGridCopy for FeatureGrid.
Evaluates a graph: every node's sockets and values, and the wires it refuses.

AnyType.title: AnyType
AnyType.description: An input that takes whatever type is wired into it.

ChoiceType.title: ChoiceType
ChoiceType.description: One of a fixed set of options, such as an HTML tag.

Component.title: Component
Component.description: A component, with its graph and screen sizes.

ComponentContent.title: ComponentContent
ComponentContent.description: What a save stores, with the version it started from.

ElementType.title: ElementType
ElementType.description: Rendered markup, such as an HTML element with its children.

End.title: End
End.description: A socket of a node: where a wire starts or ends.

Evaluated.title: Evaluated
Evaluated.description: Every node of the graph, by node, and why each refused wire is refused, by wire.

Graph.title: Graph
Graph.description: Nodes and wires. A new component's graph is `{}`, which is a graph of neither.

GroupSocket.title: GroupSocket
GroupSocket.description: A socket group. Its rows are named like `children/<row id>`.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: What the join page shows of the team.

InviteLink.title: InviteLink
InviteLink.description: What makes a team's invite link: compono.app/join/{token}.

ListedComponent.title: ListedComponent
ListedComponent.description: A component in its project's list, without its graph.

ListedProject.title: ListedProject
ListedProject.description: A project in the list of a team's projects.

MemberName.title: MemberName
MemberName.description: A project member's name, for their avatar.

MemberRole.title: MemberRole
MemberRole.description: The role to give a member of a project.

NewComponent.title: NewComponent
NewComponent.description: A new component. Named Untitled, Untitled2... when the name is left out.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: One node. A socket of a group is named like `children/<row id>`.

NodeTypeInfo.title: NodeTypeInfo
NodeTypeInfo.description: A node type, for the Add node menu, the canvas and the properties panel.

NothingType.title: NothingType
NothingType.description: No value. A wire that brings Nothing counts as no wire.

NumberType.title: NumberType
NumberType.description: A number. Its subtype Integer is a whole number.

ObjectType-Input.title: ObjectType
ObjectType-Input.description: Named fields, each with a socket type of its own.

ObjectType-Output.title: ObjectType
ObjectType-Output.description: Named fields, each with a socket type of its own.

Position.title: Position
Position.description: Where a node sits on the canvas.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: A project, with the signed-in account's role in it.

ProjectChanges.title: ProjectChanges
ProjectChanges.description: What to change of a project. What's left out stays.

ProjectRole.title: ProjectRole
ProjectRole.description: What an account can do in a project.

Prop.title: Prop
Prop.description: A value the component takes from whoever uses it. Component Input gives each prop as an output.

Reason.title: Reason
Reason.description: Why a token signs nobody in.

Saved.title: Saved
Saved.description: The component's version after the save, which the next save starts from.

ScreenSize.title: ScreenSize
ScreenSize.description: A named width that the preview renders at, like Desktop 1280.

SlotType.title: SlotType
SlotType.description: Where a component renders. It takes an Element.

TeamChanges.title: TeamChanges
TeamChanges.description: What to change of a team.

TeamRole.title: TeamRole
TeamRole.description: What an account can do in a team.

TextType.title: TextType
TextType.description: Text. Its subtype Link is an address to go to.

Wire.title: Wire
Wire.description: From an output to an input.
